name: Denizli Buyuksehir Belediyesi Modular Data Center
developer: Denizli Buyuksehir Belediyesi (Bilgi Islem Dairesi Baskanligi)
notes: Official public tender announcement (EKAP no 2026/1431291, ilan.gov.tr ILN02528088) by Denizli Metropolitan Municipality Information Processing Dept for procurement of a modular data center system, delivery to Inciliplnar Mah. Pamukkale/Denizli within 90 days of contract; tender opening 03.09.2026. Procurement stage; capacity unknown.

name: Turkcell Edirne Veri Merkezi
notes: Data-center directory and local-map sources identify Turkcell's Edirne data center; method-driven search found no operator page or MW figure, so facility existence remains C-grade directory evidence.

name: Elazig academic data center concept project
developer: Aganlar Architecture / Akdemir Architecture / academic campus client
notes: Arkitera project page identifies a data-center project in Elazig; public sources do not confirm final delivery, operator, or capacity.

name: Erzincan Binali Yildirim University main data center
notes: University IT infrastructure page describes an expanded main system room/data center supporting campus services (institutional); no MW figure disclosed.

name: Ataturk University National Data Center Project
notes: Ataturk University announced a national data-center project (ATABAUM, first proposed 2017); Sabah coverage confirms the project proposal history. No capacity or construction completion found.

name: Erzurum province data center investment initiative
notes: 2026: Erzurum Governorate held coordination meetings on data center investment with an investor company presentation and digital-infrastructure roadmap; provincial officials (incl. governor Aydin Barus) pledged follow-through. No site, permit, or capacity announced yet.

name: Anadolu University 'Anadolu Veri Merkezi'
notes: Anadolu University opened its Anadolu Data Center in Eskisehir with a ceremony; local press describes it among the largest university data centers in Turkey. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Eskisehir Metropolitan Municipality ESKI server/data-center room
notes: Municipality tender covers server/data-center room construction, mechanical, electrical and installation work for ESKI; no MW figure disclosed.

name: Veganet Datacenter Gaziantep
developer: Veganet Teknolojileri ve Hizmetleri LTD STI
notes: Veganet operates a datacenter at Gaziantep Teknopark (Sahinbey): 200 m2 system room, 300 m2 energy/UPS room, 52 m2 office (552 m2 total) per operator/forum material; PeeringDB facility 16613 and DataCenterMap list 2 Gaziantep facilities. Capacity MW not disclosed.

name: Gaziantep University data-center infrastructure
notes: Integrator project page describes Gaziantep University data-center infrastructure including UPS and electrical/environmental systems; institutional; no MW figure.

name: Hakkari University data-center system room
notes: University activity-report material references the main system room/data-center environment and security controls (institutional); no MW figure.

name: Suleyman Demirel University Data Center procurement
notes: Open tender (EKAP, Public Procurement Law 4734 art.19) by Suleyman Demirel University for data center setup procurement; official university procurement proceeding. Capacity unknown.

name: Isparta operating data center (unnamed operator)
notes: June 2026 Sabah column (echoing AA-style national roundups) states one data center is operating in Isparta among listed provinces; operator and capacity not named. Weak lead.

name: MERTELKOM Data and Technology Center
developer: Mersin Buyuksehir Belediyesi Imar Insaat A.S.
notes: MERTELKOM is Mersin Metropolitan Municipality's data and technology center (Toroslar district), designed to Tier 3 level and serving municipal/regional data hosting with high-availability connectivity; local press and municipal subsidiary pages. No MW figure.

name: Equinix Istanbul Campus (IL1-IL4)
notes: Equinix Istanbul campus (Umraniye/Yukari Dudullu OSB) comprises IL1-IL4. IL4 opened 31 Oct 2024: 7.5 MW fully built out, 1,125 cabinets, 3,045 sqm colo space, designed for high-density/AI compute; IL2 provides additional capacity. Campus combined ~22 MW IT load (industry sources).

name: Turk Telekom Istanbul Data Centers (Esenyurt & Gayrettepe)
notes: Turk Telekom operates data centers at Esenyurt (European side, Tier III-grade colo/cloud/managed services) and Gayrettepe (Istanbul Internet Data Center) plus Ankara/Umitkoy; ~12,700 m2 white space across the three facilities per official cloud page. MW not published.

name: Is Bankasi Atlas Data Center (Tuzla)
notes: Is Bankasi flagship Atlas Data Center in Tuzla (~32,000 sqm) operating since 2018, Tier IV Gold operational sustainability; operated via IsNet with TS EN 50600 certification. No public MW figure.

name: Vodafone Turkey Istanbul Data Center
notes: Vodafone Turkey operates data centers in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and Adana (5 facilities pre-Edgnex JV) offering managed IT/colocation; Istanbul is a major node. Capacity not published.

name: ENKA Data Solutions Tuzla Data Center
notes: ENKA Data Solutions operates a Tier III carrier-neutral data center in Tuzla offering colocation, GPU/AI infrastructure; ENKA progress page gives 11 MW IT load for the Tuzla project. April 2025 event at the facility confirms operations.

name: NGN Star of Bosphorus Data Center
notes: Official NGN page: first Uptime Institute Tier III Design & Facility-certified operator-neutral commercial data center in Turkey; 16 MW total power, ~5,000 m2 white space, 2,000+ standard cabinets, ~24,000 m2 indoor; opened 2018.

name: Teknotel Telehouse Istanbul
notes: Telehouse Istanbul (with Teknotel) is one of Turkey's first carrier-neutral data centers, Tier 3+, located Kozyatagi (Asian side, since March 2011) per official Teknotel and Telehouse pages. Capacity not published.

name: AWS Istanbul Local Zone
notes: AWS Istanbul Local Zone became generally available 2026-05-20, bringing compute/networking/storage in-country (single-digit ms latency). A-grade for cloud local-zone existence only; per methodology the physical facility is not an AWS-owned datacenter (Direct Connect at Equinix IL4 since 2025).

name: IGA Istanbul Airport Data Center (Phase 1)
notes: Data Center Catalog lists an IGA Data Center Phase-1 at Istanbul Airport; telecom/data infrastructure on site per job postings. No operator/capacity officially confirmed.

name: IBB Basaksehir Data Center
notes: Public-sector data center for IBB in Basaksehir (directory evidence); serves municipal IT services; capacity not published.

name: KocSistem Camlica Data Center
notes: KocSistem data center at Camlica (Uskudar), Istanbul; hosting/cloud services (directory evidence); capacity not published.

name: Mars Datacenter IST-1
notes: Mars Datacenter IST-1, Istanbul colocation prepared to TS EN 50600 standards (directory + official site); capacity not published.

name: Radore Data Center
notes: Radore operates a Tier III-standard data center in MetroCity (Istanbul) with ~10,000 server capacity and 7/24 monitoring per official page; capacity MW not published.

name: Pen Veri Merkezi (PenDC)
notes: Pen Veri Merkezi (PenDC), Istanbul colocation provider (~400 racks, Novec 1230 fire suppression per catalog; new ownership since 2021); capacity not published.
